title: setup with no or a wrong subcommand, setup hook --scope, a stray word or an unknown flag are usage errors (exit 2) and write nothing
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). `jitso setup` names what is missing and prints the usage; `setup hooks` is an unknown subcommand; `setup hook --scope user` (and `--scope=user`) says the command writes this checkout's `.claude/settings.json` only; a positional word or a flag the command does not declare is `unknown argument`. The `--scope` message wins before any flag parsing, and `.claude` is never created.

stderr.regex:
^jitso setup: missing what to set up \(hook[^)]*\)

Usage: jitso setup hook \[--absolute\] \[--remove\] \[--dry-run\] \[--yes\]
^jitso setup: unknown subcommand "hooks"\n\nUsage: jitso setup hook

stderr.equals: JITSO REJECTED: setup hook writes this checkout's .claude/settings.json only; --scope is not supported
JITSO REJECTED: setup hook writes this checkout's .claude/settings.json only; --scope is not supported
